answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fake identities. The fable that identities are free fails: each epoch opens 50 slots, and a random beacon sets one clearing price for one bid each. Each winner posts a 40-unit bond, twice 30 days of earnings, locked for 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 units sunk; an honest agent pays one bond, recovers it, and earns undiluted rewards. A river boat queues for one berth and pays its own fare at the jetty.
